blocks.title: Testing
blocks.text: Testing software ko jaanchne ka amal hai ta ke yaqeeni ho ke woh requirements poori kare aur tawaqqo ke mutabiq kaam kare. Yeh ek darja-bandi par chalti hai jo chhote hisson se shuru ho kar poore nizam tak jati aur users ki manzoori par khatam hoti hai.

items: Unit testing: alag alag units akele test.
Integration testing: units mil kar test.
Acceptance testing: users ya clients tay karte hain ke software tayyar hai ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: Testing ki chaar satahein kis tarteeb mein hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Unit, phir integration, phir system, phir acceptance testing: sab se chhote hisson se poore nizam tak aur aakhir mein users ki manzoori.

items: Testing: requirements ke muqable software jaanchna; darja-bandi: unit, integration, system, acceptance.
